description: This file defines a utility container class for creating, deserializing, and parsing AcknowledgementRequest objects related to the 'acks' component of the Eclipse Ditto model. It includes static factory methods, parsing, and deserialization for acknowledgement requests, and references related classes like AcknowledgementLabel, Set, JsonObject, and others.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequests
classes.description: A final utility class providing factory methods for creating, deserializing, and parsing AcknowledgementRequest instances and related filtered acknowledgement requests within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest instance given an AcknowledgementLabel.

methods.name: newFilteredAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableFilteredAcknowledgementRequest with specified includes and filter.

methods.name: filteredAcknowledgementRequestFromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into an ImmutableFilteredAcknowledgementRequest.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence representation into an ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest, performing null check and label parsing.
